title: sharded-kv-prefetch-and-attention-step-scheduler-for-mistral-qwen
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: observed tail latency and throughput regressions for mixed short+long requests on Mistral- and Qwen-derived model families when using the default global KV cache and stride-agnostic attention kernels. This PR introduces a sharded KV slab layout with per-shard prefetch policies and an attention-step scheduler that picks kernel micro-batches by aligned token stride to avoid unaligned GPU memcpy penalties. Goals: 1) reduce p95/p99 latency for long-context workloads, 2) increase overall token/s when requests with heterogeneous lengths are coalesced, 3) provide configuration knobs for Dedicated customers to tune eviction vs prefetch aggressiveness. Changes: implemented sharded_kv_slab with lightweight per-shard LRU+age hybrid eviction; added prefetch_policy module that computes reuse_score by combining token-age, recent-access-count, and sequence-affinity; attention-step scheduler (attn_step_scheduler) that groups microbatches by step-alignment and picks kernels that are stride-aware; kernel_selector hints to prefer planar kernels for Mistral long-context patterns and fallback to compact kernels for many short sequences; model quirks files for mistral and qwen to expose recommended default shard counts and kernel hinting. Benchmarks: internal bench shows 8-12% lower p95 on mixed loads and 15-22% higher tokens/s on long-context synthetic traces; CI includes new perf test that validates numerical parity for a 4k-step rollout. Rollout plan: feature-flag behind runtime.experimental.sharded_kv, gradual canary on Dedicated with telemetry for cache-hit and kernel-fallback events. See linked linear items for rollout and alert thresholds.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial sharded KV slab data structure and tests; prefetch policy algorithm and telemetry events; attn-step scheduler implementation and kernel hint plumbing; model quirks and defaults for Mistral/Qwen; perf tests and docs updates + small followup fix for edge-case eviction.

release_notes: Performance: Sharded KV cache with adaptive prefetching and attention-step scheduler improves p95/p99 latency and token throughput for Mistral and Qwen families. Configurable via runtime.experimental.sharded_kv and model quirks files.
